title: score_response
description: Record a private working score for one competency, on a scale of 1 to 5 where 1 is poor and 5 is excellent. This steers your own planning; it is not the final grade and the candidate never sees it. Optional fields accept null: the model emits null to mean 'no preference', and rejecting that spends a repair turn on a call that was not actually wrong. Required fields stay strict, where a null IS a mistake worth correcting.

score.description: Integer from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent). Must not exceed 5.
